text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hah ha ha ha! I messed up big time...
again!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I feel like doing a somersault and
crying from
the agony! This is
Bakushin-level pain!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Bakushin-level pain... Would it
perhaps be
beneficial to Bakushin in this
condition?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps my Bakushin would be even
greater?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A tricky situation can be an opportunity!
This is
the perfect moment to grow as a
class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A tricky situation can be an opportunity!
This is
the perfect moment to grow as a
class
representative!
choice_data_list: If you're the class rep, you need ...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what do you mean?
choice_data_list: If you're the class rep, you need ...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying... instead of leading the
students
as I should... doing this would
make me the cause
of worry?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Agh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ow... It hurts...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
N-no, that's not it! The pain I'm feeling
now... is
coming from my heart!
choice_data_list: It's the pain from the injury afte...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I overlooked such a vital part of my
duties... I'm
crying from the pain in my
heart!

Sakura Bakushin O focuses on getting
better
while reflecting deeply on her
actions.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm going to take the
gamble!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wait... Gamble? As in gambling?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: WAAIIIT! NO, NO! I take it back!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That was dangerous! Engaging in
gambling would
be one step removed
from delinquency!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No! I am a class representative on the
straight and narrow! I noticed my error,
so I have to make
sure I keep on the
right path!
choice_data_list: No, it was just a figure of speech...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
B-but... maybe a small gamble wouldn't
hurt... As
a bit of social experiment...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
NO, NO, NO! What am I saying?! That is
not how
one Bakushins down the road of
the elite!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Sakura Bakushin O! OPEN
YOUR EYES!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... For some reason... I feel super tired...

Sakura Bakushin O wrestles hard with her
devotion as class representative. It
may be that she's just tired... or perhaps
it is her injury acting
up.

To start, I'll have her stretch to see how
she's
doing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well? What do you make of this
flexibility! I've
improved, don't you
think?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Yes, indeed! It seems my
theory was
correct!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for believing in me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now look upon me! My skills as a class

representative have reached a new level
and
allowed me to overcome my injury!

Sure enough, she's able to resume her
training
soon after. Whatever those skills
may be, they are
impressive.
